fullPassage:
The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal.

(B) The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system.

(A) However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world.

(C) Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and imports.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① importance — mechanisms — adequate: 원문 일치. 식량 안보 달성에 큰 중요성(importance)을 부여하고, 다양한 메커니즘(mechanisms)이 개발되었으며, 충분한(adequate) 양의 식량 확보가 과제 ←정답
❌ ② indifference — mechanisms — adequate: (A) indifference(무관심)는 importance(중요성)의 반의어. 정부가 식량 안보에 무관심하다는 것은 문맥상 부적절
❌ ③ importance — obstacles — adequate: (B) obstacles(장애물)는 mechanisms(방법)의 반의어. 목표 실현을 위해 장애물이 개발되었다는 것은 비논리적
❌ ④ importance — mechanisms — insufficient: (C) insufficient(불충분한)는 adequate(충분한)의 반의어. 불충분한 양의 식량이라면 안보 달성 맥락에 모순
det.tip: attach great importance(큰 중요성을 부여하다) / mechanisms to realize(실현하기 위한 방법) / adequate amounts(충분한 양)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① foreign — sensitive — productive: (A) foreign(외국의)은 domestic(국내의)의 반의어. 국내 농업 시스템에서 온다는 맥락에서 부적절
❌ ② domestic — resistant — productive: (B) resistant(저항력 있는)는 sensitive(민감한)의 반의어. 농산물이 기후에 저항력이 있다면 수입 필요성과 모순
❌ ③ domestic — sensitive — unproductive: (C) unproductive(비생산적인)는 productive(생산적인)의 반의어. 극도로 비생산적인 농업이라면 자급자족 논의가 무의미
✅ ④ domestic — sensitive — productive: 원문 일치. 국내(domestic) 농업 시스템, 기후에 민감한(sensitive) 농산물, 극도로 생산적인(productive) 농업 부문 ←정답
det.tip: domestic farming system(국내 농업 시스템) / sensitive to climatic conditions(기후 조건에 민감한) / extremely productive sectors(극도로 생산적인 부문)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① realize — stabilize — relying: (B) stabilize(안정시키다)는 vary(다양하다)의 반의어. 기후/토양 조건이 안정적이라면 수입 불필요 논리가 성립하지 않음
❌ ② abandon — vary — relying: (A) abandon(포기하다)은 realize(실현하다)의 반의어. 목표를 포기하기 위해 방법이 개발되었다는 것은 비논리적
❌ ③ realize — vary — abandoning: (C) abandoning(포기하는)은 relying(의존하는)의 반의어. 국내 생산과 수입을 포기한다는 것은 식량 확보 맥락에 모순
✅ ④ realize — vary — relying: 원문 일치. 목표를 실현(realize)하기 위해, 조건이 다양하게 변하며(vary), 국내 생산과 수입 모두에 의존(relying)하여 해결 ←정답
det.tip: to realize this goal(이 목표를 실현하다) / tend to vary around the world(세계적으로 다양하다) / relying on both(둘 다에 의존하여)

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to ①<u>achieving</u> food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are ②<u>available</u> to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system. However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can ③<u>export</u> food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of ④<u>assuring</u> adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and imports.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 식량 안보 ①달성(achieving), 거주 인구에게 ②이용 가능한(available), 국내에서 쉽게 생산되지 않는 식품을 ③수출(export→import), 적절한 식량 공급을 ④보장하는(assuring)
det.analysis:
✅ ① achieving: 식량 안보를 '달성'하다 — 문맥 적절
✅ ② available: 식량이 거주 인구에게 '이용 가능한' — 문맥 적절
❌ ③ export→import: 국내에서 쉽게 생산되지 않는 품목을 '수출'하는 것이 아니라 '수입'해야 함. export(수출)는 import(수입)의 반의어 ←정답
✅ ④ assuring: 적절한 식량 공급을 '보장'하다 — 문맥 적절
det.tip: import(수입하다) ↔ export(수출하다). 국내 생산 불가 품목은 수입해야 한다는 맥락

However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly ③<u>sensitive</u> to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully ④<u>self-sufficient</u> in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and imports.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 다양한 메커니즘이 ①개발되었다(developed), ②부재하는(absent→resident) 인구, 기후에 ③민감한(sensitive), 완전히 ④자급자족하지(self-sufficient) 못한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① developed: 메커니즘이 '개발되었다' — 문맥 적절
❌ ② absent→resident: '부재하는' 인구에게 식량을 제공한다는 것은 비논리적. '거주하는(resident)' 인구가 원문 ←정답
✅ ③ sensitive: 농산물이 기후에 '민감한' — 문맥 적절
✅ ④ self-sufficient: 완전히 '자급자족하지' 못한다 — 문맥 적절
det.tip: resident(거주하는) ↔ absent(부재하는). 식량은 거주 인구에게 제공되어야 함

The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of ②<u>insuring</u> that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system. However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily ③<u>produced</u> within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①사실상(virtually) 모든 나라, 충분한 양을 ②보장하는(insuring), 국내에서 쉽게 ③생산되지(produced) 않는, 문제가 ④복잡해진다(complicated→solved)
det.analysis:
✅ ① virtually: '사실상' 모든 나라 — 문맥 적절
✅ ② insuring: 충분한 양의 식량 확보를 '보장하는' — 문맥 적절
✅ ③ produced: 국내에서 쉽게 '생산되지' 않는 품목 — 문맥 적절
❌ ④ complicated→solved: 식량 공급 문제가 '복잡해진다'가 아니라 국내 생산과 수입에 의존하여 '해결된다'가 맥락. complicated(복잡해진)은 solved(해결된)의 반의어 ←정답
det.tip: solved(해결된) ↔ complicated(복잡해진). 본문은 국내 생산+수입으로 '해결'한다고 서술

However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with <u>extremely</u> productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and imports.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 extremely와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① slightly: '약간' — extremely의 반의어
❌ ② moderately: '적당히' — 강도가 extremely보다 훨씬 약함
❌ ③ remarkably: '놀랍게도' — 정도보다는 놀라움의 뉘앙스가 강해 정확한 동의어가 아님
✅ ④ highly: '매우, 대단히' — extremely와 가장 가까운 정도 부사 ←정답
det.tip: extremely productive = highly productive (극도로 생산적인)

questions.passage:
(A) The governments of virtually every country on the planet <u>face</u> challenges in dealing with environmental issues.

(B) She looked at the <u>face</u> of the old clock hanging on the wall to check the time.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 face의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 직면하다 — (B) 시계의 표면: (A)에서 face는 '도전에 직면하다'라는 동사, (B)에서 face는 '시계의 문자판/표면'이라는 명사 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 직면하다 — (B) 사람의 얼굴: (B)는 old clock의 face이므로 사람의 얼굴이 아님
❌ ③ (A) 향하다 — (B) 시계의 표면: (A)에서 face challenges는 '직면하다'이지 '향하다'가 아님
❌ ④ (A) 향하다 — (B) 사람의 얼굴: (A), (B) 둘 다 의미가 맞지 않음
det.tip: face: 동사 '직면하다' (face challenges) / 명사 '표면, 문자판' (the face of the clock)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a system, device, or method for achieving a particular result"

det.analysis:
✅ ① mechanism: '특정 결과를 달성하기 위한 시스템/장치/방법' — 영영풀이와 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② obstacle: '장애물' — 달성이 아닌 방해하는 것
❌ ③ tendency: '경향' — 결과 달성 수단이 아닌 방향성
❌ ④ condition: '조건' — 달성 수단이 아닌 상황/환경
det.tip: mechanism — 본문에서 식량 안보 달성을 위해 개발된 방법/메커니즘

det.analysis: a wide __________ of 구문에서 명사가 필요. vary(동사)를 variety(명사)로 변환. 'a wide variety of mechanisms'(다양한 메커니즘).
